hook: OU cuts water, power to *three* hostels; students protest
hook_b: OU cuts water, power to *three* hostels; students protest
tldr: Osmania University students protested on Friday demanding power and water be restored to the E1, E2 and D hostels, and opposed their proposed demolition.

beats.what: Protesters said the administration was trying to push students to go home, though many are in law courses or preparing for government recruitment exams.
beats.why: The university has proposed demolishing the three hostel buildings.
beats.care: Protesters were detained and shifted to a local police station.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Students also demanded job notifications for OU teaching and non-teaching posts.

cards.q: What should OU do with the E1, E2 and D hostels?

qs: Where will hostel students stay if the buildings are demolished?
What has OU said about the power and water cuts?

facts.t: BRSV says *one year* has passed since the CM's campus visit and Rs 1,000 crore promise.

viz.l: OU funds: promised vs released (BRSV claim)
viz.verdict: Students' group says promised funds have not arrived; no official response in the report

watch: Whether OU restores supply or sets a demolition and relocation plan.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Osmania University students protest over water, power cuts in hostels

fact: OU students protest as water and power are cut to *three* hostels
twist: BRSV says *none* of the *Rs 1,000 crore* the CM promised OU a year ago has been released.
